mau.name: Adidas Adizero EVO SL

technicalSpecs.version: Version 1, ra mat cuoi 2024 - thi truong 2025/2026
technicalSpecs.outsole: Liquid/Textured rubber mong, khong phai Continental
technicalSpecs.durability: Du kien 500-650 km tuy can nang, form chay va be mat duong

technologies: 100% Lightstrike Pro full-length: em sau, nay nhanh, khong bi cam giac qua lun neu chay dung toc do.
No Plate: khong carbon plate, khong EnergyRods; cam giac tu nhien hon va ban chan phai tu lam viec nhieu hon.
Rocker geometry / toe-spring ro: ho tro chuyen buoc muot khi tang pace.
Engineered mesh upper: mong, nhe, thoang, nhung phan got toi gian co the can that runner's loop.
Liquid/Textured rubber outsole: bam tot tren duong kho, can can trong hon khi duong uot.

fitSizing.sizingNote: True-to-size voi chan thuong; chan be nhieu nen can nhac tang 0.5 size hoac do long trong truoc khi chot. Neu bi long got, uu tien that day kieu runner's loop.

bestFor: Runner da co nen tang, muon giay sieu nhe cho tempo/interval/daily speed.
Phu hop nhat pace 4:00-5:30/km, cu ly 5K-21K.
Nguoi muon trai nghiem super-foam Lightstrike Pro nhung khong muon cam giac cung cua carbon plate.
avoidFor: Nguoi moi can giay on dinh, de di va cham hon.
Runner tren 85kg, co co chan yeu, overpronation/flat feet ro.
Nguoi tim giay di bo lau, tap gym, trail hoac chay duong uot tron thuong xuyen.

webContent.shortDescription: Adidas Adizero EVO SL la speed trainer khong plate, dung full Lightstrike Pro, rat nhe va hop runner da co nen tang can giay tempo/daily speed.
webContent.intro: Adidas Adizero EVO SL mang cam hung tu Adios Pro Evo 1 nhung loai bo plate de tao cam giac nhe, nay va tu nhien hon. Diem manh la trong luong thap, bo dem Lightstrike Pro full-length va rocker chuyen buoc muot; diem can can nhac la do on dinh ngang chi trung binh va got co the can that day ky.
features: Sieu nhe trong phan khuc speed trainer de day.
Cam giac nay tu nhien, khong bi day cuong buc nhu giay carbon.
Tot nhat cho tempo, interval, 5K-10K va half marathon voi runner co co chan khoe.
Gia tri cao neu muon trai nghiem full Lightstrike Pro trong tam gia speed trainer.
technologies: Liquid/Textured rubber outsole, khong phai Continental
bestFor: Runner trung cap den nang cao.
5K, 10K, half marathon va long run nhanh 25-30km neu co co chan khoe.
notFor: Nguoi can stability cao hoac co chan/phom dap lech trong ro.
Di bo lau, tap gym, trail, duong uot tron.
webContent.fitGuide: True-to-size nhung om sat kieu racing fit. Toe-box vua phai, phan got toi gian co the hoi long voi mot so nguoi.
webContent.sizeNote: Chan thuong di dung size; chan be nhieu nen thu/do long trong hoac tang 0.5 size. Neu long got, that runner's loop truoc khi doi size.
webContent.comparisonNote: EVO SL nhe va tu nhien hon Boston 12, nhung Boston 12 on dinh va ben hon nho EnergyRods/cau truc chac hon.

mau.sourceSummary: Tong hop tu RunRepeat, Adidas, Believe In The Run, Road Trail Run, Doctors of Running, Kofuzi va bai nghien cuu AI do TopRun cung cap; TopRun dung de bien tap thanh profile tu van noi bo.

mau.name: Nike Pegasus 41

fitSizing.sizingNote: Uu tien lam mau daily trainer cho nguoi moi; can do long trong va forefoot width.

bestFor: Nguoi moi chay can mot doi daily de dung.
Khach chay 3-10km nhieu buoi/tu tuan.
avoidFor: Trail dia hinh hoac can support manh.
mau.sourceSummary: RunRepeat xep Pegasus 41 theo huong daily trainer/versatile reference; TopRun quy doi thanh diem noi bo.

mau.name: ASICS Novablast 5

fitSizing.sizingNote: Can do width vi dong Novablast thuong duoc khach quan tam ve do rong/upper.

bestFor: Daily trainer em va co do nay.
Khach muon mot doi chay deu, long run nhe, khong qua racing.
avoidFor: Nguoi thich de thap/chac va it bounce.
mau.sourceSummary: Dung RunRepeat/brand specs lam reference cho nhom responsive daily, sau do TopRun can do fit-size rieng.

mau.name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 31

fitSizing.sizingNote: Can hoi them lich su dau/co chan va do vom chan; khong tu van nhu chan doan y khoa.

bestFor: Khach can daily on dinh hon neutral shoe.
Nguoi co xu huong can support khi chay dai/easy.
avoidFor: Nguoi khong thich cam giac structured.
mau.sourceSummary: RunRepeat co lab/review cho Kayano; TopRun dung lam reference stability category.

mau.name: Adidas Adizero Boston 12

fitSizing.sizingNote: Can canh bao nguoi moi neu muon cam giac mem/de di.

bestFor: Runner da chay deu, muon bai tempo/long run nhanh.
Khach can super trainer gia tri hon race shoe.
avoidFor: Nguoi moi can daily em de lam quen.
Khach chi di bo/di lam ca ngay.
mau.sourceSummary: Reference cho nhom tempo/super trainer; TopRun can chinh theo feedback khach Viet Nam.

mau.name: HOKA Clifton 9

fitSizing.sizingNote: HOKA can do ky chieu dai va do om midfoot/instep cho khach mu cao.

bestFor: Khach can daily em, nhe tuong doi, de chay easy.
Nguoi moi thich cam giac dem day.
mau.sourceSummary: Reference cho nhom max cushion daily/easy run.

mau.name: Nike Vaporfly 3

fitSizing.sizingNote: Chi goi y khi khach co muc tieu race/toc do; can check fit ky vi race fit co the om.

bestFor: Race day va runner da quen giay nhanh/carbon.
Khach co muc tieu PR 10K-HM-FM.
avoidFor: Nguoi moi mua doi dau tien.
Daily run cham, di bo, can on dinh cao.
mau.sourceSummary: Reference cho nhom race carbon, can tu van canh bao ro.

mau.name: HOKA Speedgoat 6

fitSizing.sizingNote: Trail shoe can can du mui nhieu hon cho xuong doc; do long trong theo size la bat buoc.

bestFor: Trail, duong dat/da, chay dai dia hinh.
Khach can de bam va bao ve chan hon road shoe.
avoidFor: Khach can giay toc do mat duong.
